## Overview

This script loads the finalized legacy pan-cancer age-analysis outputs needed for part 1 and standardizes them for the manuscript workflow.

It prepares:

- age-association count tables,
- a simple layer manifest for downstream extension,
- file manifests for RNA-seq GSEA and multi-omic clustering, and
- organ-system annotations used in figure panels.

The goal is to save one clean imported-results object that downstream part-1 Rmds can reuse.

```{r}
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)

})
```

## RNA-seq summary input

```{r}
rnaseq_dir <- layer_manifest$results_dir[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RNAseq"]
rnaseq_filtered_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = rnaseq_dir,
  pattern = layer_manifest$filtered_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RNAseq"],
  full.names = TRUE
))

if (length(rnaseq_filtered_files) == 0) {
  stop("No RNA-seq filtered DESeq2 result files were found in: ", rnaseq_dir)
}

RNAseq_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  rnaseq_filtered_files,
  function(file_path) {
    x <- readRDS(file_path) %>%
      as.data.frame()

    x$Project <- stringr::str_extract(basename(file_path), "TCGA-[^_]+")
    x$direction <- ifelse(x$log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down")

    x %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Project = dplyr::first(Project),
        Total_Features = dplyr::n(),
        Q_Value_0.05 = sum(padj <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q_Value_0.025 = sum(padj <= 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q_Value_0.01 = sum(padj <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
        IncreasedExp_with_Age = sum(padj <= 0.05 & direction == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
        DecreasedExp_with_Age = sum(padj <= 0.05 & direction == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
)
```

## Mutation summary input

```{r}
mutation_dir <- layer_manifest$results_dir[layer_manifest$layer_id == "Mutation"]
mutation_results_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = mutation_dir,
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "Mutation"],
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
))

if (length(mutation_results_files) == 0) {
  stop("No mutation result files were found in: ", mutation_dir)
}

Mutation_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  mutation_results_files,
  function(file_path) {
    x <- readRDS(file_path)

    if (!"all" %in% names(x)) {
      stop("Mutation result file does not contain an 'all' entry: ", file_path)
    }

    x_all <- x[["all"]] %>%
      as.data.frame()

    dplyr::summarise(
      x_all,
      Project = basename(dirname(file_path)),
      Total_Features = dplyr::n(),
      Q_Value_0.05 = sum(adj_p_val <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q_Value_0.025 = sum(adj_p_val <= 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q_Value_0.01 = sum(adj_p_val <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
      Positive_Association = sum(adj_p_val <= 0.05 & beta > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Negative_Association = sum(adj_p_val <= 0.05 & beta < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)
```

## SCNA summary input

```{r}
scna_dir <- layer_manifest$results_dir[layer_manifest$layer_id == "SCNA"]
scna_results_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = scna_dir,
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "SCNA"],
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
))

if (length(scna_results_files) == 0) {
  stop("No SCNA result files were found in: ", scna_dir)
}

SCNA_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  scna_results_files,
  function(file_path) {
    x <- readRDS(file_path)

    if (!all(c("amplified_two_levels", "deleted_two_levels") %in% names(x))) {
      stop("SCNA result file is missing amplified/deleted gene-level tables: ", file_path)
    }

    amp_df <- x[["amplified_two_levels"]] %>%
      as.data.frame()

    del_df <- x[["deleted_two_levels"]] %>%
      as.data.frame()

    dplyr::tibble(
      Project = basename(dirname(file_path)),
      Total_Features = nrow(amp_df) + nrow(del_df),
      Q_Value_0.05 = sum(amp_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(del_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q_Value_0.025 = sum(amp_df$adj_p_val <= 0.025, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(del_df$adj_p_val <= 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q_Value_0.01 = sum(amp_df$adj_p_val <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE) + sum(del_df$adj_p_val <= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
      Positive_Association = sum(amp_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05 & amp_df$beta > 0, na.rm = TRUE) +
        sum(del_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05 & del_df$beta > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Negative_Association = sum(amp_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05 & amp_df$beta < 0, na.rm = TRUE) +
        sum(del_df$adj_p_val <= 0.05 & del_df$beta < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)
```

## Raw-result file manifest

```{r}
rnaseq_unfiltered_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = rnaseq_dir,
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RNAseq"],
  full.names = TRUE
))

mirna_unfiltered_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = mirna_dir,
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "miRNA"],
  full.names = TRUE
))

methylation_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = layer_manifest$results_dir[layer_manifest$layer_id == "Methylation"],
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "Methylation"],
  full.names = TRUE
))

rppa_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = layer_manifest$results_dir[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RPPA"],
  pattern = layer_manifest$clustering_pattern[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RPPA"],
  full.names = TRUE
))

result_file_manifest <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    layer_id = "RNAseq",
    result_use = "filtered_deseq",
    Project = stringr::str_extract(basename(rnaseq_filtered_files), "TCGA-[^_]+"),
    file_path = rnaseq_filtered_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "RNAseq",
    result_use = "unfiltered_deseq",
    Project = stringr::str_remove(basename(rnaseq_unfiltered_files), fixed(layer_manifest$clustering_suffix[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RNAseq"])),
    file_path = rnaseq_unfiltered_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "miRNA",
    result_use = "filtered_deseq",
    Project = stringr::str_extract(basename(mirna_filtered_files), "TCGA-[^_]+"),
    file_path = mirna_filtered_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "miRNA",
    result_use = "unfiltered_deseq",
    Project = stringr::str_remove(basename(mirna_unfiltered_files), fixed(layer_manifest$clustering_suffix[layer_manifest$layer_id == "miRNA"])),
    file_path = mirna_unfiltered_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "Methylation",
    result_use = "limma",
    Project = stringr::str_remove(basename(methylation_files), fixed(layer_manifest$clustering_suffix[layer_manifest$layer_id == "Methylation"])),
    file_path = methylation_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "RPPA",
    result_use = "limma",
    Project = stringr::str_remove(basename(rppa_files), fixed(layer_manifest$clustering_suffix[layer_manifest$layer_id == "RPPA"])),
    file_path = rppa_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "Mutation",
    result_use = "with_covariates_all",
    Project = basename(dirname(mutation_results_files)),
    file_path = mutation_results_files
  ),
  tibble(
    layer_id = "SCNA",
    result_use = "with_covariates_gene_level",
    Project = basename(dirname(scna_results_files)),
    file_path = scna_results_files
  )
)
```

## Standardize age-association counts

```{r}
all_projects <- sort(Reduce(
  union,
  list(
    DMR_summary$Project,
    RPPA_summary$Project,
    RNAseq_summary$Project,
    miRNA_summary$Project,
    Mutation_summary$Project,
    SCNA_summary$Project
  )
))

standardize_counts <- function(df, positive_col, negative_col, layer_label, project_levels) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Project = as.character(Project),
      Positive = .data[[positive_col]],
      Negative = .data[[negative_col]]
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(Project = project_levels, fill = list(Positive = 0, Negative = 0)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Layer = layer_label)
}

fig1a_counts_wide <- bind_rows(
  standardize_counts(DMR_summary, "Hypermethylation", "Hypomethylation", "Methylation", all_projects),
  standardize_counts(RNAseq_summary, "IncreasedExp_with_Age", "DecreasedExp_with_Age", "RNA-seq", all_projects),
  standardize_counts(miRNA_summary, "IncreasedExp_with_Age", "DecreasedExp_with_Age", "miRNA", all_projects),
  standardize_counts(RPPA_summary, "IncreasedExp_with_Age", "DecreasedExp_with_Age", "RPPA", all_projects),
  standardize_counts(Mutation_summary, "Positive_Association", "Negative_Association", "Mutation", all_projects),
  standardize_counts(SCNA_summary, "Positive_Association", "Negative_Association", "SCNA", all_projects)
)

fig1a_long <- fig1a_counts_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Positive, Negative),
    names_to = "Regulation",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Count = ifelse(Regulation == "Negative", -Count, Count),
    Cancer = stringr::str_remove(Project, "^TCGA-"),
    Layer = factor(Layer, levels = layer_manifest$figure_label[layer_manifest$include_in_fig1a]),
    Regulation = factor(Regulation, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
    Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = rev(sort(unique(Cancer))))
  )
```

## Save official imported-results object

```{r}
part1_imported_results <- list(
  legacy_root = legacy_root,
  colleague_root = colleague_root,
  organ_annotations = organ_annotations,
  organ_palette = organ_palette,
  layer_manifest = layer_manifest,
  result_file_manifest = result_file_manifest,
  layer_summaries = list(
    Methylation = DMR_summary,
    RNAseq = RNAseq_summary,
    miRNA = miRNA_summary,
    RPPA = RPPA_summary,
    Mutation = Mutation_summary,
    SCNA = SCNA_summary
  ),
  fig1a_long = fig1a_long
)

saveRDS(
  part1_imported_results,
  file.path(derived_dir, "part1_imported_results.rds")
)

utils::write.csv(
  fig1a_long,
  file = file.path(tables_dir, "fig1a_feature_counts_long.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  result_file_manifest,
  file = file.path(tables_dir, "part1_result_file_manifest.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
